title: Add Case Studies section to redwood-docs (nav, SEO, content loading)
creator: Ben Carter
description:
## Context
Marketing is launching a structured Case Study + Customer Reference Program (3–5 design partners). We need a first-class "Case Studies" section in the public docs site so Sales/CS can link prospects to credible production stories.

This ticket covers:
- Adding a Case Studies entry point in docs navigation
- Creating the landing page + routing structure
- Basic SEO (titles/descriptions, canonical URLs, sitemap inclusion)
- Content loading pattern for case studies (so marketing can add new stories without engineering changes)

Non-goals:
- Copywriting the case studies themselves (Marketing owns)
- Major redesign beyond the new section (Design provides components via DES-214)

## Requirements / Scope
### Information architecture
- Add a top-level navigation item: **Case Studies**
- Provide a landing page at `/case-studies` with:
  - hero/intro
  - list of case studies (cards)
  - filters (optional v1; OK to ship without filters if it risks timeline)
- Each case study lives at `/case-studies/<slug>`

### Content model
We need a simple, stable content schema for each story:
- Title
- Customer name (or anonymized label)
- Deployment mode (Hosted / Dedicated / Private)
- Industry
- Summary (1–2 sentences)
- Outcomes (2–4 bullets; numbers must be sourced/approved)
- Optional: architecture diagram image
- Optional: callouts (e.g., "Security & compliance")

Implementation preference: MDX files with frontmatter + a shared page template.

### SEO basics
- Add `<title>` and meta description for landing page + each case study page.
- Canonical URLs set to production domain.
- Ensure pages are included in sitemap and not blocked by robots.
- If we have internal-only drafts:
  - support `draft: true` (or `visibility: internal`) frontmatter
  - internal drafts should be excluded from build output *or* published with `noindex, nofollow` and not in sitemap.

### Performance / Loading
- Listing page should not require client-side fetch for content. Build-time/static generation is preferred.
- Avoid heavy bundles on `/case-studies` (cards only; keep images optimized).

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Docs nav includes a "Case Studies" link to `/case-studies`.
- [ ] `/case-studies` renders a list of case studies driven by content files (no code changes needed to add a new story).
- [ ] `/case-studies/<slug>` pages render with consistent layout (header, sections, outcomes).
- [ ] Landing page + a sample story page have correct title + meta description.
- [ ] Draft/internal stories are not discoverable via sitemap and are not indexed.
- [ ] Local dev instructions documented (where to add new stories, required frontmatter fields).
- [ ] Release steps completed (see below) and verified in production.

## Implementation Notes (proposed)
- Add `case-studies/` directory under docs content root.
- Add a small loader:
  - at build time, read all MDX files under `case-studies/`
  - parse frontmatter, sort by publish date
  - build routes for each slug
- Frontmatter fields (v1):
  - `title`
  - `slug`
  - `customer`
  - `deployment_mode`
  - `industry`
  - `summary`
  - `outcomes` (comma-separated string or YAML list; if YAML list creates nesting in our tooling, store as a single string and parse)
  - `published_at`
  - `draft` (true/false)
  - `meta_title`
  - `meta_description`

## Links / Related
- Design: DES-214 (Case study page layout + PDF template)
- PM scope: PM-684 (Customer Reference Program Launch)
- Related docs PR: `sources/github/redwood-docs/pr_842_add-case-studies-section-and-templates.json`

## Release Steps
1) Merge PR to `redwood-docs` after reviews from:
   - Marketing (Soojin Lee) for IA/wording
   - Design (Tessa Morgan) for component compliance
2) Validate on preview deploy:
   - `/case-studies` loads and lists stories
   - at least 1 story page renders correctly
   - meta tags present
   - draft story not indexed / not in sitemap
3) Production deploy
4) Post-deploy checks:
   - run Lighthouse on `/case-studies`
   - validate sitemap contains the public case study URLs only
   - confirm nav links from homepage/docs sidebar

## Risks / Open Questions
- Draft handling: do we want drafts excluded from build entirely vs `noindex`? Excluding is safer.
- Filters/search: defer to v2 if it threatens timeline.
- "Outcomes" data structure: keep it simple to avoid schema churn; Marketing can format content in MDX.

## Updates
- 2025-06-02 (Ben): Implemented `/case-studies` route + nav entry; content driven by MDX frontmatter.
- 2025-06-07 (Ben): Added `draft` gating + sitemap exclusion; added meta title/description defaults.
- 2025-06-12 (Soojin): Requested copy tweak: use "Customer stories" as on-page H1 but keep nav label as "Case Studies" for consistency with enablement docs.
- 2025-06-18 (Ben): Open PR up for review; waiting on Design sign-off re: card spacing and mobile truncation.
